summary: Existing not-comparable reason re-tested and confirmed. GEO GSE314029 deposits only raw counts (one supplementary file, the registered input). The paper (PMID 42056522, PMC13190304) reports bulk RNA-seq results only for liver, eWAT and skeletal muscle (12-day treatment); the hypothalamus is covered only by acute 7 h single-dose proteomics (PRIDE PXD062990) and FOS counts, which differ in molecule class, cohort, dose and timepoint. No same-estimand hypothalamic author table exists, so no author-concordance-v2 comparison can be formed; no ledger change proposed.
